images.prompt: a bright cheerful children's playroom: a big soft rug in the middle, a low wooden toy shelf, a bowl of purple grapes, a whole pizza on a plate, a hot dog on a bun, a small cute cat sitting on the rug, a round panda plush toy, and three fat crayons (one bright green, one bright blue, one bright pink) scattered on the floor. Exactly two children: Mia: a girl with brown twin-tails wearing a coral pinafore dress over a white shirt, and Ben: a boy with short black hair wearing a blue shirt and dark shorts, playing on the rug. Only these two children, no other people.
